issues.detail: The Greek 'εκ δηναριου' (from a denarius) indicates the rate of pay (a denarius per day), but the Vietnamese 'mỗi ngày một đơ-ni-ê' changes the structure slightly. More importantly, the Greek 'την ημεραν' (the day) is part of the pay description ('a denarius [for] the day'), while the Vietnamese phrasing makes it sound like a routine of 'every day', potentially blurring the specific contractual agreement of 'a denarius per day'.
